definitions.play: regular-season pass or run, not a two-point try, with an EPA value
definitions.epaRush: designed runs: a run that is not a dropback
definitions.successRate: share of plays with positive EPA
definitions.explosiveRate: share of plays gaining 15+ yards on a dropback or 10+ on a designed run
definitions.blitzRate: share of FTN-charted dropbacks with 5+ pass rushers; 4-man rush = exactly four
definitions.timeToThrow: Next Gen passer-weeks weighted by attempts; the defense's is the opposing passers' weeks against it
definitions.ranks: offense descending, defense ascending; blitz rate and time to throw most to least on both sides; ties share a rank; percentile = (32 - rank) / 31
